name: Vietnam Museum of Ethnology
nameVi: Bảo tàng Dân tộc học Việt Nam
kicker: Galleries and outdoor houses in Nghia Do
summary: Give the museum time for the outdoor houses as well as the galleries. It opens 8:30 to 17:30, except Mondays and the New Year holiday named on the site. Admission is 40,000 VND. The address is Nguyen Van Huyen, Nghia Do. Vietnam Tourism describes 54 ethnic groups and the outdoor houses.
heroCaption: An outdoor house at the Museum of Ethnology

notice.title: Closed Monday
notice.body: The museum site says 8:30 to 17:30 except Mondays and New Year’s Holiday. The English brochure on the same site says the Lunar New Year.

body: The outdoor ground holds wooden houses on stilts and smaller buildings set in the trees. Vietnam Tourism describes galleries for 54 ethnic groups and these outdoor houses. The visit length was not published. Check on arrival.

The museum site prints 8:30 to 17:30 except Mondays and New Year’s Holiday, and 40,000 VND admission. The English brochure says except Mondays and the Lunar New Year. The address is Nguyen Van Huyen Street, Nghia Do. Vietnam Tourism agrees on the 40,000 VND fee and the hours. A ride from Hoan Kiem has no published minute count.

figures.caption: A path and a thatched house in the outdoor ground
figures.alt: A path beside a thatched house at the Museum of Ethnology

gettingThere: Nguyen Van Huyen Street, Nghia Do. This is not a walk from the lake. No minute count from Hoan Kiem was published. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Hoan Kiem
legs.body: By car or motorbike. The minutes are check on arrival.

hours: 8:30–17:30. Closed Monday. The site also closes for New Year’s Holiday. The brochure says the Lunar New Year.
closed: Monday, and the New Year holiday named on the museum site.
admissionNote: 40,000 VND on the museum site and on Vietnam Tourism.
